Full shaping orchestration: ShapePlan + shape() entry.

Mirrors harfrust shape.rs / ot/layout.rs. Arabic joining, fallback presentation forms (unicode and win1256), Hebrew composition and mark reorder, Hangul jamo composition, Thai SARA AM split and PUA fallback, Indic consonant-syllable reordering, Khmer Coeng/Ro pref reordering, Myanmar reph positioning, USE repha/pref recording and post-base reordering, mark/cursive GPOS, and fallback mark positioning are implemented; stch stretching stays TODO.
